description: Wave 0 adversarial English pass (orchestrator, 2026-11-18) over the 4 keys wave0_keyset.php --new-and-changed leaves for review (lpn_inp_drop_quality_options, lpn_settings_viscosity_tip, lpn_quality_diffusivity, lpn_quality_diffusivity_tip) and the new lpn_about_source.
